name: gumroad-mcp
description: Gumroad (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, create_product, update_price, list_sales, re

platform_mcp_gumroad_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_gumroad_access_token.description: Gumroad access token (Settings > Advanced > Applications > Create application > Generate access token; scopes view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, edit_sales) sent as Authorization: Bearer. The API page's curl examples pass the same token as the access_token parameter instead.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /user (view_profile) returns {success, user{bio, name, twitter_handle, user_id, email (view_sales scope), url, profile_picture_url}}.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /products returns ALL of the account's products unpaged: {success, products[{id, name, description, price (INTEGER in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 100 = $1.00), currency (lowercase, e.g. usd), published, deleted, short_url, thumbnail_url, sales_count, ...}]}. `page`/`limit`/`status` are not sent (ignore next_page); published/deleted are booleans in raw, so `status` is null; created/updated timestamps are not returned.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /products/:id returns {success, product{...}} with the same fields as list_products; `price` is an integer in the smallest currency unit and `status` is null (see raw.published / raw.deleted).

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: POST /products {name, description (HTML), price (required; INTEGER in the smallest currency unit — pass 1000 for $10.00), price_currency_type (ISO code, defaults to the account currency), draft: true} (edit_products scope) saves an UNPUBLISHED DRAFT digital product; publish it with PUT /products/:id/enable (not mapped). `url` is not accepted (custom_permalink is a slug, files/covers are separate uploads).

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: PUT /products/:id {price (INTEGER in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 for $10.00), price_currency_type} sends only those fields (edit_products scope). Not allowed for tiered memberships (tier prices are variants). Returns the updated product.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /sales?after=since (DATE in the form YYYY-MM-DD; a datetime is not documented)&product_id (view_sales scope) lists successful sales, newest first: {success, next_page_key, sales[{id, email, product_id, product_name, price (INTEGER, smallest currency unit), currency, created_at, order_id, refunded, partially_refunded, chargedback, disputed, paid, license_key, ...}]}. Paging is by page_key/next_page_key, which page/limit cannot carry: `page` and `limit` are not sent and only the first page (raw next_page_key for the rest) is returned; `status` is null.

tools.name: refund
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: PUT /sales/:id/refund {amount_cents} (edit_sales scope) refunds the sale in FULL when `amount` is omitted, or partially by `amount` — which is sent as amount_cents, i.e. an INTEGER in the minor units of the sale's `currency` (200 = 2.00 USD/EUR/...; JPY has no minor unit, so 200 = ¥200). Multiple partial refunds are allowed until fully refunded. `reason` is not accepted. Returns {success, sale{... refunded, partially_refunded}}; `amount` is the sale price, `status` is null.
